scripts.greeting: This is Operator Lilith. Which focus state should I initialize for your node? You may say: Red State for critical operations, Blue State for normal mode, Green State to initiate, or Amber State to hold and observe.
scripts.focus_prompt: Please say your desired focus state after the tone.
scripts.thankyou: Thank you for using Lilith Private LTE Network. Your session is logged and secured. Have a productive cycle.
scripts.network_status: Lilith Private LTE Network status: All systems operational. Your connection is secure. Signal strength optimal on band 7.

focus_responses.red: Focus state Red initialized. Critical operations mode engaged. All priority channels are now active. Proceed with caution.
focus_responses.blue: Focus state Blue confirmed. Normal operations mode active. All systems running within standard parameters.
focus_responses.green: Focus state Green initiated. Ready mode engaged. Your node is prepared for activation. Awaiting your command.
focus_responses.amber: Focus state Amber set. Observation mode active. Monitoring and analysis protocols engaged. Stand by for updates.
focus_responses.unknown: I'm sorry, I didn't understand your selection. Please try again. Say Red, Blue, Green, or Amber.
